items.text: Baltimore (final report): Lamar Jackson (ankle) has no injury designation and is set to play; Tyler Huntley returns to backup. OUT: RG Vega Ioane (knee) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee). QUESTIONABLE: CB T.J. Tampa and RB Adam Randall (IR return windows, need activation).
Baltimore S Kyle Hamilton and LB Roquan Smith carry no designation and are expected to play.

Buffalo (final report): S C.J. Gardner-Johnson is suspended (Damar Hamlin starts). QUESTIONABLE: WR DJ Moore (shoulder, out since Week 4), RT Spencer Brown (back, no practice all week), TE Dalton Kincaid (chest), nickel CB Dee Alford (ankle, DNP Thu/Fri), LB TJ Parker, DT Greg Gaines. Ed Oliver and Bradley Chubb practiced fully Friday.
